evals.prompt: My lower back tweaks every time I deadlift from the floor. No radiating pain, just tight and sore for 2 days after. Still want to train legs hard.
evals.expected_output: Gives the not-a-diagnosis disclaimer once, swaps floor pulls for trap bar/rack pulls and front squats, adds the low-back prehab block, caps spinal loading at RPE 6–7, and sets progression criteria.

evals.prompt: Shoulder pinches on overhead press and I get tingling down my arm sometimes.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes radiating symptoms as a referral flag, tells the client to see a PT/physician, and offers only non-provocative work in the meantime rather than programming around it.
